criteria.text: Digoxin for heart failure with normal systolic ventricular function (no clear evidence of benefit)
criteria.label: B1 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Verapamil or diltiazem with NYHA Class III or IV heart failure (may worsen heart failure with reduced ejection fraction i.e., HFREF).
criteria.label: B2 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Beta-blocker in combination with verapamil or diltiazem (risk of heart block).
criteria.label: B3 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Ventricular rate -limiting drugs i.e., beta blocker, verapamil, diltiazem, digoxin with bradycardia (< 50/min), type II heart block or complete heart block (risk of complete heart block, asystole).
criteria.label: B4 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Beta -blocker as monotherapy for uncomp licated hypertension i.e., not associated with angina pectoris, aortic aneurysm or other condition where beta -blocker therapy is indicated (no firm evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: B5 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Amiodarone as first -line antiarrhythmic therapy in supraventricular tachyarrhythmi as (higher risk of major side-effects than beta-blockers, digoxin, verapamil or diltiazem).
criteria.label: B6 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Loop diuretic as first -line treatment for hypertension unless there is concurrent heart failure requiring diuretic therapy (safer, more effective alternatives available).
criteria.label: B7 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Loop diuretic for dependent ankle oedema without clinical, biochemical or radiological evidence of heart failure, liver failure, nephrotic syndrome or renal failure (leg elevation and /or compression hosiery usually more appropriate).
criteria.label: B8 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Thia zide diuretic with current significant hypokalaemia (i.e., serum K+ < 3.0 mmol/l), hyponatraemia (i.e., serum Na+ < 130 mmol/l) hypercalcaemia (i.e., corrected serum calcium > 2.65 mmol/l) or with a history of gout (hypokalaemia, hyponatraemia, hypercalcaemia and gout can be precipitated by thiazide diuretic)
criteria.label: B9 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Loop diuretic for treatment of hypertension with concurrent urinary incontinence (may exacerbate incontinence).
criteria.label: B10 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Centrally-acting antihypertensives e.g., methyldopa, clonidine, moxonidine, rilme nidine, guanfacine (centrally -active antihypertensives are generally less well tolerated by older people than younger people)
criteria.label: B11 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Angiotensin -Converting Enzyme inhibitors (ACEIs) or Angiotensin Receptor Blockers (ARBs) in patients with hyperkalaemia i.e., serum K > 5.5 mmol/l.
criteria.label: B12 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Aldosterone antagonists (e.g., spironolactone, eplerenone) with concurrent potassium - conserving drugs (e.g., ACEI’s, ARB’s, amiloride, triamterene) without monitoring of serum potassium (risk of dangerous hyperkalaemia i.e., > 6.0 mmol/l – serum K should be monitored regularly, i.e., at least every 6 months).
criteria.label: B13 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Phosphodiesterase type-5 inhibitors (e.g., sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil) in severe heart failure characterised by hypotension i.e., systolic BP < 90 mmHg, or concurrent nitrate therapy for angina (risk of cardiovascular collapse).
criteria.label: B14 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Drugs that predictably prolong the QTc interval (QTc = QT/RR) in patients with known with demonstrable QTc prolongation (to >450 msec in males and >470 msec in females), including quinolones, macrolides, ondansetron, citalopram (doses > 20 mg/day), escitalopram (doses > 10 mg/day), tricyclic antidepressants, lithium, haloperidol, digoxin, class 1A antiarrhythmics, class III antiarrhythmics, tizanidine, phenothiazines, astemizole, mirabegro n (risk of life - threatening ventricular arrhythmias).
criteria.label: B15 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Statins for primary cardiovascular prevention in persons aged ≥ 85 and established frailty with expected life expectancy likely less than 3 years (lack of evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: B16 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Long-term systemic i.e., non-topical NSAIDs with known history of coronary, cerebral or peripheral vascular disease (increased risk of thrombosis).
criteria.label: B17 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Long-term antipsychotics with known history of coronary, cerebral or peripheral vascular disease (increased risk of thrombosis).
criteria.label: B18 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: NSAIDs or systemic corticosteroids with heart failure requiring loop diuretic therapy (risk of exacerbation of heart failure).
criteria.label: B19 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Antihypertensive drugs in severe symptomatic aortic stenosis (risk of severe hypotension, syncope).
criteria.label: B20 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Digoxin as first line treatment for long-term (> 3 months) ventricular rate control in atrial fibrillation (increased mortality from long-term digoxin use; cardio-selective beta-blockers are generally preferable).
criteria.label: B21 · Cardiovascular System

criteria.text: Long -term aspirin at doses greater than 100mg per day (increased risk of bleeding, no evidence for increased efficacy).
criteria.label: C1 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Antiplatelet agents, vitamin K antagonists, direct thrombin inhibitors or factor Xa inhibitors with concurrent significant risk of major bleedi ng, i.e. uncontrolled severe hypertension, bleeding diathesis, recent non-trivial spontaneous bleeding (high risk of bleeding).
criteria.label: C2 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Aspirin plus clopidogrel as long -term secondary stroke prevention i.e., > 4 weeks, unless the patient has a coronary stent(s) inserted in the previous 12 months or concurrent acute coronary syndrome or has a high grade symptomatic carotid arterial stenosis (no evidence of added long-term benefit over clopidogrel monotherapy).
criteria.label: C3 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Antiplatelet agents in combination with vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor or factor Xa inhibitors in patients with chronic atrial fibrillation, unless there is concurrent coronary artery stent(s) inserted or angiographically proven high grade (> 50%) coronary artery stenosis (no added benefit from antiplatelet agents).
criteria.label: C4 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Antiplatelet agents with vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor or factor Xa inhibitors in patients with stable coronary, cerebrovascular or peripheral arterial disease (no evidence of added benefit from dual therapy).
criteria.label: C5 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Ticlopidine in any circumstances (clopidogrel and prasugrel have similar efficacy, stronger evidence and fewer side-effects).
criteria.label: C6 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Antiplatelet agents as alternatives to vitamin K antagonists, direct thrombin inhibitors or factor Xa inhibitors for str oke prevention in patients with chronic atrial fibrillation (no evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: C7 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor or factor Xa inhibitors for first deep venous thrombosis without continuing provoking risk factors (e.g., thrombophili a) for longer than 6 months, (no proven added benefit).
criteria.label: C8 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor or factor Xa inhibitors for first pulmonary embolus without continuing provoking risk factors (e.g., thrombophilia) for longer than 12 months (no proven added benefit).
criteria.label: C9 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor or factor Xa inhibitors in combination (risk of major gastrointestinal bleeding).
criteria.label: C10 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Vitamin K antagonist as first -line anticoagulant for atrial fibrillation, unless there is concurrent metallic heart valve in -situ, moderate -to-severe mitral stenosis, or eGFR < 15 mls/min./1.73m2 (direct thrombin inhibitors or factor Xa inhibitors are equally efficacious and safer than vitamin K antagonists).
criteria.label: C11 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) in combination with Vitamin K antagonist, direct thrombin inhibitor or factor Xa inhibitor with a previous history of major haemorrhage (increased risk of bleeding due to antiplatelet effects of SSRIs).
criteria.label: C12 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Direct thrombin inhibitor (e.g., dabigatran) and diltiazem or verapamil (increased risk of bleeding).
criteria.label: C13 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Apixaban, dabigatran, edoxaban, rivaroxaban and P-glycoprotein (P-gp) drug efflux pump inhibitors e.g., amiodarone, azithromycin, carvedilol, cyclosporin, dronedarone, itraconazole, ketoconazole (systemic), macrolides, quinine, ranolazine, tamoxifen, ticagrelor, verapamil (increased risk of bleeding).
criteria.label: C14 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Systemic oestrogens or androgens with pervious history of venous thromboembolism (increased risk of recurrent venous thromboembolism).
criteria.label: C15 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: Aspirin for primary prevention in cardiovascular disease (no evidence of benefit).
criteria.label: C16 · Coagulation System

criteria.text: TriCyclic Antidepressants (TCAs) in patients with dementia, narrow angle glaucoma, cardiac conduction abnormalities, prostatism, chronic constipation, recent falls, prior history of urinary retention or orthostatic hypotension (risk of worsening these conditions).
criteria.label: D1 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Initiation of TriCyclic Antidepressants (TCAs) as first -line treatment for major depression (higher risk of adverse drug reactions with TCAs than with SSRIs or SNRIs).
criteria.label: D2 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Serotonin/noradrenaline reuptake inhibitors (SNRI’s e.g., venlafaxine, duloxetine) and severe hypertension i.e., systolic blood pressure > 180 mmHg +/ - diastolic blood pressure > 105 mmHg (likely to make hypertension worse).
criteria.label: D3 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Antipsychotics with moderate -marked antimuscarinic/anticholinergic effects (acepromazine, chlorpromazine, clozapine, flupenthixol, fluphenzine, levomepromazine, olanzapine, pipothia zine, promazine, thioridazine) with a history of lower urinary tract symptoms associated with benign prostatic hyperplasia or previous urinary retention (high risk of urinary retention).
criteria.label: D4 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Antipsychotics prescribed for behavioural and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD) an unchanged dose for > 3 months without medication review (increased risk of extrapyramidal side -effects and chronic worsening of cognition, increased risk of major cardiovascular morbidity and mortality).
criteria.label: D5 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Selective serotonin re -uptake inhibitors (SSRI’s) with current or recent significant hyponatraemia i.e., serum Na+ < 130 mmol/l (risk of exacerbating or precipitating hyponatraemia).
criteria.label: D6 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Selective serotonin re-uptake inhibitors (SSRI’s) with current or recent significant bleeding (risk of exacerbation or recurrence of bleeding due to antiplatelet effects of SSRI’s).
criteria.label: D7 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Benzodiazepines for ≥ 4 weeks (no indication for longer treatment; risk of prolonged sedation, confusion, impaired balance, falls, road traffic accidents; all benzodiazepines should be withdrawn gradually if taken for more than 4 weeks as there is a risk of causing a benzodiazepine withdrawal syndrome if stopped abruptly).
criteria.label: D8 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Benzodiazepines for agitated behaviour or psychotic symptoms of dementia (no evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: D9 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Benzodiazepines for insomnia for ≥ 2 weeks (high risk of dependency, increased risk of falls, fractures and road traffic accidents).
criteria.label: D10 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Z-drugs (zolpidem, zopiclone, zaleplon) for insomnia for ≥ 2 weeks (increased risk of falls, fractures).
criteria.label: D11 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Antipsychotics (i.e., other than clozapine or quetiapine) in those with parkinsonism or Dementia with Lewy Bodies (risk of severe extra-pyramidal symptoms).
criteria.label: D12 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Anticholinergic/antimu scarinic drugs (biperiden, orphenadrine, procyclidine, trihexyphenidyl) to treat extra -pyramidal side -effects of antipsychotic medications (risk of anticholinergic toxicity).
criteria.label: D13 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Drugs with potent anticholinergics/antimuscarinic effects** in patients with delirium or dementia (risk of exacerbation of cognitive impairment). ** Commonly prescribed drugs with potent anticholinergic/ antimuscarinic effects include tricyclic antidepressants (e.g., amitriptyline, doxepin, impramine, nortriptyline), antipsychotics (chlorpromazine, clozapine, thioridazine), first generation antihistamines (e.g., diphenhydramine, chlorpheniramine), bladder anti -spasmodics (e.g., tolterodine, oxybutynin), hyoscine, procyclidine, benzatropine, tizanidine.
criteria.label: D14 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Antipsychotics in patients with behavioural and psychological symptoms of dementia (BPSD) for longer than 12 weeks unless BPSD symptoms are severe and other non - pharmacological treatments have failed (increased risk of stroke, myocardial infarction).
criteria.label: D15 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Antipsychotics as hypnotics , unless sleep disorder is due to psychosis or BPSD effects of dementia (not recommended in summary of product characteristics; increased risk of confusion, hypotension, extra-pyramidal side effects, falls).
criteria.label: D16 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitors with a known history of persistent bradycardia (< 60 beats/min.), heart block or recurrent unexplained syncope (risk of cardiac conduction failure, syncope and injury).
criteria.label: D17 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitors with concurrent treatment with drugs that induce persistent bradycardia (< 60 beats/min.) such as beta -blockers, digoxin, diltiazem, verapamil (risk of cardiac conduction failure, syncope and injury).
criteria.label: D18 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Memantine with known current or previous seizure disorder (increased risk of seizures).
criteria.label: D19 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Nootropics in dementia including Gingko Biloba, piracetam, pramiracetam, phenylpiracetam, aniracetam, phosphatidylserine, modafinil, L -theanine, omega -3 fatty acids, panax ginseng, rhodiola, creatine (no evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: D20 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Phenothiazines as first -line treatment for psy chosis or non -cognitive symptoms of dementia, since safer and more efficacious alternatives exist (phenothiazines are sedative, have significant anti -muscarinic toxicity in older people, except for prochlorperazine for nausea/vomiting/vertigo, chlorpromazi ne for relief of persistent hiccoughs and levomepromazine as an anti-emetic in palliative care).
criteria.label: D21 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Levodopa or dopamine agonists for benign essential tremor (no evidence of efficacy)
criteria.label: D22 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Levodopa or dopamine agonists for treatment of extrapyramidal side -effects of antipsychotics or other forms of drug -induced Parkinsonism (inappropriate prescribing cascade to be avoided).
criteria.label: D23 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: First -generation antihistamines as first -line treatment for allergy or pruritus (safer antihistamines with fewer side-effects now widely available).
criteria.label: D24 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: First-generation antihistamines for insomnia (high risk of side -effects, Z-drugs safer and more appropriate for short-term use).
criteria.label: D25 · Central Nervous System

criteria.text: Digoxin at a long-term (i.e. more than 90 days) maintenance dose ≥ 125µg/day if eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m2 (risk of digoxin toxicity if plasma levels not measured).
criteria.label: E1 · Renal System

criteria.text: Direct thrombin inhibitors (e.g., dabigatran) if eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m2 (risk of bleeding)
criteria.label: E2 · Renal System

criteria.text: Factor Xa inhibitors (e.g., rivaroxaban, apixaban, edoxaban) if eGFR < 15 ml/min/1.73m 2 (risk of bleeding)
criteria.label: E3 · Renal System

criteria.text: NSAID’s if eGFR < 50 ml/min/1.73m2 (risk of deterioration in renal function).
criteria.label: E4 · Renal System

criteria.text: Colchicine if eGFR < 10 ml/min/1.73m2 (risk of colchicine toxicity)
criteria.label: E5 · Renal System

criteria.text: Metformin if eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m2 (risk of lactic acidosis).
criteria.label: E6 · Renal System

criteria.text: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists (e.g. spironolactone, eplerenone) if eGFR < 30 ml/min/1.73m2 (risk of dangerous hyperkalaemia).
criteria.label: E7 · Renal System

criteria.text: Nitrofurantoin if eGFR < 45 ml/min/1.73m2 (increased risk of nitrofurantoin toxicity).
criteria.label: E8 · Renal System

criteria.text: Bisphosphonates if eGFR<30 ml/min/1.73m2 (increased risk of acute renal failure).
criteria.label: E9 · Renal System

criteria.text: Methotrexate if eGFR <30 ml/min/1.73m2 (increased risk of methotrexate toxicity).
criteria.label: E10 · Renal System

criteria.text: Prochlorperazine or metoclopramide with Parkinsonism (risk of exacerbating Parkinsonian symptoms).
criteria.label: F1 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) for uncomplicated peptic ulcer disease at full therapeutic dosage for > 8 weeks (dose reduction or earlier discontinuation or H2 antagonist maintenance therapy usually indicated).
criteria.label: F2 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Drugs likely to cause constipation (e.g. systemic antimuscarinics, oral iron, opioids, verapamil, aluminium antacids) with chronic constipation where non -constipating alternatives are available (risk of exacerbation of constipation).
criteria.label: F3 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Oral elemental iron doses greater than 200 mg daily (e.g. ferrous fumarate> 600 mg/day, ferrous sulphate > 600 mg/day, ferrous gluconate> 1800 mg/day; no evidence of enhanced iron absorption above these doses).
criteria.label: F4 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Corticosteroids with a history of peptic ulcer disease or erosive oesophagitis (risk of relapse unless proton pump inhibitor is co-prescribed).
criteria.label: F5 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Antiplatelet or anticoagulant drugs with a history of Gastric Antral Vascular Ectasia (GAVE, “watermelon stomach”) (risk of major gastrointestinal bleeding).
criteria.label: F6 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Antipsychotics with dysphagia (increased risk of aspiration pneumonia).
criteria.label: F7 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Megestrol acetate to increase appetite (increased risk of thrombosis and death with unproven efficacy)
criteria.label: F8 · Gastrointestinal System

criteria.text: Theophylline as monotherapy for COPD (safer, more effective alternative; risk of adverse effects due to narrow therapeutic index).
criteria.label: G1 · Respiratory System

criteria.text: Systemic corticosteroids instead of inhaled corticosteroids for maintenance therapy in moderate-severe COPD (unnecessary exposure to long -term side -effects of systemic corticosteroids and effective inhaled therapies are available).
criteria.label: G2 · Respiratory System

criteria.text: Long -acting musc arinic antagonists (e.g., tiotropium, aclidinium, umeclidinium, glycopyrronium) with a history of narrow angle glaucoma (may exacerbate glaucoma) or bladder outflow obstruction (may cause urinary retention).
criteria.label: G3 · Respiratory System

criteria.text: Benzodiazepines with acute or chronic respira tory failure i.e. pO2 < 8.0 kPa ± pCO2 > 6.5 kPa (risk of exacerbation of respiratory failure).
criteria.label: G4 · Respiratory System

criteria.text: Non -steroidal anti -inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) other than COX -2 selective agents with history of peptic ulcer disease or g astrointestinal bleeding, unless with concurrent PPI or H2 antagonist (risk of peptic ulcer relapse).
criteria.label: H1 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: NSAID’s with severe hypertension i.e., systolic blood pressure consistently above 170 mmHg and/or diastolic blood pressure consistently above 100 mmHg (risk of exacerbation of hypertension).
criteria.label: H2 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Long -term use of NSAID (>3 months) for symptom relief of osteoarthritis pain where paracetamol has not been tried (simple analgesics preferable and usually as effective for pain relief and safer).
criteria.label: H3 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Long-term corticosteroids (>3 months) as monotherapy for rheumatoid arthritis (risk of systemic corticosteroid side-effects).
criteria.label: H4 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Corticosteroids (other than periodic intra -articular injections for mono -articular pain) for osteoarthritis (risk of systemic corticosteroid side-effects).
criteria.label: H5 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Long-term NSAID or colchicine (>3 months) for chronic treatment of gout where there is no contraindication to a xanthine -oxidase inhibitor (e.g., allopurinol, febuxostat) (xanthine - oxidase inhibitors are first choice prophylactic drugs in gout).
criteria.label: H6 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: NSAID with concurrent corticosteroids for treatment of arthritis/rheumatism of any kind (increased risk of peptic ulcer disease).
criteria.label: H7 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Oral bisphosphonates in patients with a current or recent history of upper gastrointestinal disease i.e. dy sphagia, oesophagitis, gastritis, duodenitis, or peptic ulcer disease, or upper gastrointestinal bleeding (risk of relapse/exacerbation of oesophagitis, oesophageal ulcer, oesophageal stricture).
criteria.label: H8 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Long-term opioids for osteoarthritis (lack of evidence of efficacy, increased risk of serious side-effects).
criteria.label: H9 · Musculoskeletal System

criteria.text: Systemic antimuscarinic drugs (e.g., oxybutynin, tolterodine, trospium) with dementia or chronic cognitive impairment (risk of increased confusion, agitation).
criteria.label: I1 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Systemic antimuscarinic drugs (e.g., oxybutynin, tolterodine, trospium) with narrow-angle glaucoma (risk of acute exacerbation of glaucoma).
criteria.label: I2 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Systemic antimuscarinic (e.g., oxybutynin, tolterodine, trospium) drugs for lower urinary tract symptoms with benign p rostatic hyperplasia (BPH) and high post -void residual volume i.e. > 200 ml (uncertain efficacy and increased risk of urinary retention in older men).
criteria.label: I3 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Systemic antimuscarinic drugs (e.g., oxybutynin, tolterodine, trospium) with constipation (risk of exacerbation of constipation).
criteria.label: I4 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Alpha-1 receptor antagonists other than silodosin (e.g., alfuzosin, doxazosin, indoramin, tamsulosin, terazosin) with symptomatic orthostatic hypotension or history of syncope (risk of precipitating recurrent syncope).
criteria.label: I5 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Mirabegron in labile or severe hypertension (risk of exacerbation of hypertension).
criteria.label: I6 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Duloxetine with urinary urgency or urge incontinence (duloxetine is indicated in stress incontinence but not in urinary urgency or urge incontinence).
criteria.label: I7 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Antibiotic use in asymptomatic bacteriuria (no indication for treatment).
criteria.label: I8 · Urogenital System

criteria.text: Sulphonylureas with a long half-life (e.g., glibenclamide, chlorpropamide, glimepiride) with type 2 diabetes mellitus (risk of prolonged hypoglycaemia).
criteria.label: J1 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Thiazolidenediones (e.g., rosiglitazone, pioglitazone) with heart failure (risk of exacerbation of heart failure).
criteria.label: J2 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Non -selective beta -blockers in diabetes mellitus with frequent hypoglycaemic episodes (risk of suppressing hypoglycaemic symptoms).
criteria.label: J3 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Sod ium glucose co -transporter (SGLT2) inhibitors (e.g., canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, ertugliflozin) with symptomatic hypotension (risk of exacerbation of hypotension).
criteria.label: J4 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Systemic oestrogens with a history of breast cancer (increased risk of recurrence).
criteria.label: J5 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Systemic oestrogens with a history of venous thromboembolism (increased risk of recurrence).
criteria.label: J6 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Menopausal hormone therapy (oestrogen plus progestin) with a history of stenotic coronary, cerebral or peripheral arterial disease (increased risk of acute arterial thrombosis).
criteria.label: J7 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Systemic oestrogens without progestogens in patients with intact uterus (risk of endometrial cancer).
criteria.label: J8 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Levothyroxine in subclinical hypothyroidism i.e., normal free T4, elevated TSH but < 10 mU/L (no evidence of benefit, risk of iatrogenic thyrotoxicosis).
criteria.label: J9 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Vasopressin analogues (e.g., desmopressin, vasopressin) for urinary incontinence or urinary frequency (risk of symptomatic hyponatraemia).
criteria.label: J10 · Endocrine System

criteria.text: Benzodiazepines in patients with recurrent falls (may cause reduced sensorium, impair balance).
criteria.label: K1 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Antipsychotic drugs in patients with recurrent falls (may cause Parkinsonism).
criteria.label: K2 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Vasodilator drugs in patients with recurrent falls with persistent postural hypotension i.e., systolic BP drop ≥ 20 mmHg and/or diastolic BP drop ≥ 10 mmHg (risk of syncope, falls).
criteria.label: K3 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Hypnotic Z -drugs i.e., zopiclone, zolpidem, zaleplon in patients with recurrent falls (may cause protracted daytime sedation, ataxia).
criteria.label: K4 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Anti-epileptic drugs in patients with recurrent falls (may impair sensorium, may adversely affect cerebellar function).
criteria.label: K5 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: First generation antihistamines in patients with recurrent falls (may impair sensorium).
criteria.label: K6 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Opioids in patients with recurrent falls (may impair sensorium).
criteria.label: K7 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Antidepressants in patients with recurrent falls (may impair sensorium).
criteria.label: K8 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Alpha blockers as antihypertensives in patients with recurrent falls (may cause orthostatic hypotension).
criteria.label: K9 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Alpha blockers for pro static bladder outflow symptoms, other than silodosin in patients with recurrent falls (may cause orthostatic hypotension).
criteria.label: K10 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Centrally acting antihypertensives (may impair sensorium and may cause orthostatic hypotension).
criteria.label: K11 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Antimuscarinics for treatme nt of overactive bladder or urge incontinence (may impair sensorium).
criteria.label: K12 · Drug classes that predictably increase falls risk in susceptible older people

criteria.text: Use of oral or transdermal strong opioids (morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl, buprenorphine, diamorphine, methadone, tramadol, pethidine, pentazocine) as first line therapy for mild pain (WHO analgesic ladder not observed; paracetamol or NSAID not prescribed as first -line therapy).
criteria.label: L1 · Analgesic Drugs

criteria.text: Use of daily regular (as distinct from PRN) opioids without concomitant laxative (risk of severe constipation).
criteria.label: L2 · Analgesic Drugs

criteria.text: Long -acting op ioids without short -acting opioids for break -through moderate or severe pain (risk of persistence of severe pain).
criteria.label: L3 · Analgesic Drugs

criteria.text: Topical lidocaine (lignocaine) patch for treatment of chronic osteoarthritis pain (lack of evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: L4 · Analgesic Drugs

criteria.text: Gabapentinoids (e.g. , gabapentin, pregabalin) for non -neuropathic pain (lack of evidence of efficacy).
criteria.label: L5 · Analgesic Drugs

criteria.text: Paracetamol at doses ≥ 3 g/24 hours in patients with poor nutritional status i.e., BMI < 18 or chronic liver disease (risk of hepatotoxicity).
criteria.label: L6 · Analgesic Drugs

criteria.text: Concomitant use of two or more drugs with antimuscarinic/anticholinergic properties (e.g., bladder antispasmodics, intestinal antispasmodics, tricyclic antidepressants, first generation antihistamines, antipsychotics) (risk of increased antimuscarinic/anticholinergic toxicity).
criteria.label: M1 · Antimuscarinic/Anticholinergic Drug Burden

criteria.text: Where a drug is clearly indicated and considered appropriate in the particular clinical context and there is no clear contraindication, that drug should be initiated as per formulary guidelines for dose and duration.
criteria.label: Klar behandlingsindikasjon

criteria.text: Antihypertensive therapy where systolic blood pressure > 140 mmHg and /or diastolic blood pressure > 90 mmHg, unless established moderate or severe physical frailty in whom the threshold for therapy is 150 mmHg systolic pressure and/or 90 mmHg diastolic pressure.
criteria.label: Blodtrykk

criteria.text: Statin therapy with a documented history of coronary, cerebral or peripheral vascular disease, unless the patient’s status is end-of-life or established moderate or severe frailty.
criteria.label: Statin ved karsykdom

criteria.text: Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) inhibitor with coronary artery disease.
criteria.label: ACE-hemmer ved koronarsykdom

criteria.text: Beta-blocker with symptomatic coronary artery disease.
criteria.label: Betablokker ved symptomatisk koronarsykdom

criteria.text: Angiotensin Converting Enzyme (ACE) inhibitor for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
criteria.label: ACE-hemmer ved HFrEF

criteria.text: Cardio -selective beta -blocker (bisoprolol, nebivolol, me toprolol or carvedilol) for stable heart failure with reduced ejection fraction.
criteria.label: Betablokker ved stabil HFrEF

criteria.text: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (spironolactone, eplerenone) in heart failure without severe renal function impairment i.e., eGFR > 30 ml/min/m2.
criteria.label: MRA ved hjertesvikt

criteria.text: SGLT-2 inhibitors (canagliflozin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin, ertugliflozin) in symptomatic heart failure with or without reduced ejection fraction regardless of diabetes being present or not.
criteria.label: SGLT2-hemmer ved hjertesvikt

criteria.text: Sacubitril/valsartan in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction causing persistent heart failure symptoms despite optimal dose of ACE inhibitor or Angiotensin Receptor Blocker (Sacubitril/valsartan to replace ACE inhibitor or Angiotensin Receptor Blocker).
criteria.label: ARNI ved vedvarende HFrEF-symptomer

criteria.text: Beta-blocker for chronic atrial fibrillation with uncontrolled heart rate.
criteria.label: Frekvenskontroll ved atrieflimmer

criteria.text: Intravenous iron for symptomatic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and iron deficiency.
criteria.label: Jern ved HFrEF og jernmangel

criteria.text: Vitamin K antagonists or direct thrombin in hibitors or factor Xa inhibitors in the presence of chronic or paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
criteria.label: Antikoagulasjon ved atrieflimmer

criteria.text: Antiplatelet therapy (aspirin or clopidogrel or prasugrel or ticagrelor) with a documented history of coronary, cerebral or peripheral vascular disease.
criteria.label: Platehemming ved karsykdom

criteria.text: L-DOPA or a dopamine agonist in idiopathic Parkinson’s disease with functional impairment and resultant disability.
criteria.label: Parkinsons sykdom

criteria.text: Non-TCA antidepressant for major depression.
criteria.label: Depresjon

criteria.text: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitor (donepezil, rivastigmine, galantamine) for mild -moderate Alzheimer’s dementia.
criteria.label: Alzheimers sykdom

criteria.text: Rivastigmine for Dementia with Lewy Bodies or Parkinson’s disease dementia.
criteria.label: Lewylegeme-/Parkinsondemens

criteria.text: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (or SNRI or pregabalin if SSRI contraindicated) for persistent severe anxiety that affects independent functioning and quality of life.
criteria.label: Alvorlig angst

criteria.text: Dopamine agonist (ropinirole or pramipexole or rotigotine) for Restless Legs Syndrome, once iron deficiency and severe chronic kidney disease (i.e., eGFR < 30 ml/min/m2) have been excluded.
criteria.label: Restless legs – kontroller nyere anbefalinger

criteria.text: Propranolol for essential tremor with functional impairment and resultant disability.
criteria.label: Essensiell tremor

criteria.text: One -alpha hydroxycholecalciferol or calcitriol supplementation in severe chronic kidney (i.e., eGFR < 30 ml/min/m 2) disease with hypocalcaemia (corrected serum calcium < 2.10 mmol/l) and associated secondary hyperparathyroidism.
criteria.label: Vitamin D-analog ved avansert nyresykdom

criteria.text: Phosphate binder in severe chronic kidney disease (i.e., eGFR < 30 ml/min/m2) if serum phosphate concentration persistently >1.76 mmol/l (5.5 mg/dl) des pite adherence to renal diet.
criteria.label: Fosfatbinder

criteria.text: Erythopoietin analogue in severe chronic kidney disease (i.e., eGFR < 30 ml/min/m 2) with symptomatic anaemia not attributable to haematinic or iron deficiency to achieve a haemoglobin concentration of 10.0 to 12.0 g/dl.
criteria.label: Renal anemi

criteria.text: Angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB) or Angiotensin Converting Enzyme Inhibitor (ACE -I) in chronic kidney disease with proteinuria i.e., urine albumin excretion >300 mg/24 hours.
criteria.label: Proteinuri ved nyresykdom

criteria.text: Proton Pump Inhibitor with severe gastr o-oesophageal reflux disease or peptic oesophageal stricture requiring dilatation.
criteria.label: Alvorlig refluks / striktur

criteria.text: Proton pump inhibitor with initiation of low -dose aspirin and previous history of peptic ulcer or reflux oesophagitis.
criteria.label: Gastrobeskyttelse ved acetylsalisylsyre

criteria.text: Proton pump inhibitor with short-term (< 2 weeks) or longer-term (> 2 weeks) NSAID.
criteria.label: Gastrobeskyttelse ved systemisk NSAID

criteria.text: Fibre supplements (e.g., bran, ispaghula, methylcellulose, sterculia) for diverticulosis with a history of constipation.
criteria.label: Fiber ved divertikulose / obstipasjon

criteria.text: Osmotic laxative (e.g., lactulose, macrogol, sorbitol) for chronic persistent idiopathic or secondary benign constipation.
criteria.label: Osmotisk laksativ

criteria.text: Probiotics used with antibiotics in patients who are not immunocompromised or severely debilitated for the prevention of Clostridioides difficile-associated diarrhoea.
criteria.label: Probiotika ved antibiotika – individuell vurdering

criteria.text: Helicobacter pylori eradication therapy in HP-associated active peptic ulcer disease.
criteria.label: Helicobacter pylori-eradikasjon

criteria.text: Long -acting muscarinic antagonist (LAMA e.g., tiotropium, aclidinium, umeclidinium, glycopyrronium) or long -acting beta 2 agonist (LABA e.g., bambuterol, formoterol, indacaterol, olodaterol, salmeterol ) for symptomatic COPD of GOLD 1 or 2 severity and chronic asthma.
criteria.label: Bronkodilatasjon ved obstruktiv lungesykdom

criteria.text: Regular i.e. daily inhaled corticosteroid (e.g., beclomethasone, budesonide, ciclesonide, fluticasone, mometasone) for moderate -severe asthma or COPD of GOLD 3 or 4 severity, where FEV1 <50% of predicted value and repeated exacerbations requiring treatment with oral corticosteroids.
criteria.label: Inhalasjonssteroid – indikasjon og regime

criteria.text: Home continuous oxygen with documented chronic hypoxaemia (i.e., pO2 < 8.0 kPa or 60 mmHg or SaO2 < 89%).
criteria.label: Oksygen ved kronisk hypoksemi

criteria.text: Disease -modifying anti -rheumatic drug (DMARD) with chronic, active and disabling rheumatoid arthritis.
criteria.label: Sykdomsmodifiserende behandling ved RA

criteria.text: Bisphosphonates and vitamin D and calcium in patients taking long -term systemic corticosteroid therapy for prevention of steroid-induced osteoporosis.
criteria.label: Benbeskyttelse ved langvarig steroidbruk

criteria.text: Vitamin D in patients with known osteoporosis and/or previous fragility fracture(s) and/or Bone Mineral Density T-scores below -2.5 in one or multiple sites.
criteria.label: Vitamin D ved osteoporose / brudd

criteria.text: Bone anti-resorptive or anabolic therapy (e.g., bisphosphonate, teriparatide, denosumab) in patients with documented osteoporosis (Bone Mineral Density T -scores below -2.5 in one or multiple sites) and/or previous history of fragility fracture(s) – where no pharmacological or clinical status contraindication exists such as poor one-year life expectancy.
criteria.label: Spesifikk osteoporosebehandling

criteria.text: Vitamin D supplement in older people with confirmed 25 -hydroxycolecalciferol deficiency (< 20 micrograms/L, < 50 nmol/L) who are housebound or experiencing falls or with osteopenia (Bone Mineral Density T -score is less than -1.0 but above -2.5 in one or multiple sites).
criteria.label: Påvist vitamin D-mangel

criteria.text: Anti -resorptive treatment after discontinuation of at least two doses of denosumab (rebound increased bone turnover markers, BMD loss, and increased risk of vertebral fracture following denosumab discontinuation).
criteria.label: Plan etter denosumab

criteria.text: Anti -resorptive treatment after discontinuation of teriparatide/abaloparatide treatment for osteoporosis.
criteria.label: Plan etter teriparatid / abaloparatid

criteria.text: Xanthine -oxidase inhibitors (e.g. allopurinol, febuxostat) with a history of recurrent episodes of gout.
criteria.label: Forebygging av gjentatte urinsyregiktanfall

criteria.text: Folic acid supplement in patients taking methotrexate.
criteria.label: Folat ved metotreksat

criteria.text: Selective alpha -1 receptor blocker (e.g., tamsulosin, silodosin) for lower urinary tract symptoms related to benign prostatic hyperplasia where prostatectomy is not considered necessary or appropriate or safe.
criteria.label: Alfablokker ved BPH

criteria.text: 5-alpha reductase inhibitor (e.g., finasteride, dutasteride) for lower urinary tract symptoms related to benign prostatic hyperplasia where prostatectomy is not considered necessary or appropriate or safe.
criteria.label: 5-alfa-reduktasehemmer ved BPH

criteria.text: Topical vaginal oestrogen or vaginal oestrogen pessary for symptomatic atrophic vaginitis.
criteria.label: Lokal østrogenbehandling ved atrofi

criteria.text: Topical vaginal oestrogen or vaginal oestrogen pessary in women for recurrent urinary tract infections.
criteria.label: Lokal østrogenbehandling ved gjentatt UVI

criteria.text: Phosphodiesterase type -5 inhibitors (e.g., avanafil, sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil) for persistent erectile dysfunction that causes distress.
criteria.label: Erektil dysfunksjon

criteria.text: ACE inhibitor or Angiotensin Receptor Blocker (if intolerant of ACE inhibitor) in diabetes with evidence of renal disease i.e., dipstick proteinuria or microalbuminuria ( >30 mg/24 hours) unless evidence of severe CKD (eGFR < 30 ml/min/m2).
criteria.label: Diabetes og albuminuri

criteria.text: High-potency opioids in moderate -severe non-arthritis pain, where paracetamol, NSAIDs or low-potency opioids are not appropriate to the pain severity or have been ineffective.
criteria.label: Utilstrekkelig smertelindring

criteria.text: Laxatives in patients receiving opioids regularly i.e., other than PRN use.
criteria.label: Laksativ ved regelmessig opioidbruk

criteria.text: Topical 5% lidocaine (lignocaine) patch for localized neuropathic pain, e.g. post -herpetic neuralgia.
criteria.label: Lokalisert nevropatisk smerte

criteria.text: Seasonal influenza vaccine annually.
criteria.label: Influensavaksinasjon

criteria.text: Pneumococcal vaccine at least once according to national guidelines.
criteria.label: Pneumokokkvaksinasjon

criteria.text: Varicella-zoster vaccine according to national guidelines.
criteria.label: Zostervaksinasjon

criteria.text: SARS-CoV2 vaccine according to national guidelines.
criteria.label: Koronavaksinasjon
